name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began with a fascination for engineering, nurtured by his father's automotive repair shop in Medellin. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering and quickly found his niche in racing, starting as a trackside support engineer for a local touring car team. His meticulous approach and problem-solving skills propelled him through the ranks, eventually leading him to Europe where he honed his skills with various GT and prototype teams.

As Head of Operations, Ricardo is responsible for ensuring the smooth running of all trackside activities and the efficient coordination between the team's different departments. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to see the 'big picture', always striving to optimize the team's performance through strategic planning and resource allocation. Ricardo believes in empowering his team members and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, consistently pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering dedication to perfection. He has an uncanny ability to identify potential issues before they arise, ensuring that the team is always one step ahead. His commitment to detail and his relentless pursuit of excellence make him an invaluable asset to Porsche Penske Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a strong, athletic build, reflecting his dedication to fitness.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race weekend with a strong cup of Colombian coffee brewed using his personal espresso machine.
